name: rail-row-text-align
description: rail: every row's text starts at the same x at a given nesting depth - the signal dot hangs OUTDENTED in the row's leading padding (never moving the title), the inactive-fold's label lines up with its sibling session rows, and a branch row's chevron trails the label text

mutation.declaration: RailRow.module.css: .signal { margin-left: -10px } (reverted to 0 - the dotted row's title shifts one dot-column right) and .railRow { padding-left: 14px } (reverted to 0 - the dot escapes the row's left edge)
